sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.source_text:
Accessibility features help people with disabilities get the most out of their AirPods Pro.
Features include:
Live Listen audio
15
Headphone levels
Headphone Accommodations
Conversation Boost

sections.heading: System Requirements
sections.source_text:
iPhone models with the latest version of iOS
iPad models with the latest version of iPadOS
Apple Watch models with the latest version of watchOS
Mac models with the latest version of macOS
Apple TV models with the latest version of tvOS
Apple Vision Pro with the latest version of visionOS
AirPods can be used as wireless Bluetooth headphones with Apple devices using earlier software and with non‑Apple devices, but functionality may be limited.

sections.heading: AirPods Pro and the Environment
sections.source_text:
AirPods Pro with MagSafe Charging Case (USB‑C) are designed with the following features to reduce their environmental impact:
16
Made with better materials
100% recycled gold in the plating of multiple printed circuit boards
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
100% recycled aluminium in the hinge of the MagSafe Charging Case
100% recycled tin in the solder of multiple printed circuit boards
35% or more recycled plastic in multiple components
Energy Efficient
Meets US Department of Energy requirements for battery charger systems
17
Smarter chemistry
18
Mercury-, BFR-, PVC- and beryllium‑free
Green manufacturing
Apple’s Zero Waste Programme helps suppliers eliminate waste sent to landfill
All final assembly supplier sites are transitioning to 100% renewable energy for Apple production
Responsible packaging
100% of virgin wood fibre comes from responsibly managed forests
19
98% or more fibre-based packaging
20
Apple and the Environment
We’re committed to making our products without taking from the earth, and to become carbon neutral across our entire business, including products, by 2030.
See Apple’s commitment
